name: fits
description: Fits (fits-app.com) is a wardrobe app for iOS and Android. Browse the clothes you own, compose outfits from them, check and save the result, plan days and keep collections.

interface.longDescription:
Fits is the wardrobe app from fits-app.com, available for iOS and Android. You photograph your clothes once, and Fits keeps them as cut-out pieces you can combine into outfits, plan on a calendar and organise into collections.

With Fits connected, ChatGPT can see the pieces you own, with their colours, categories, warmth and formality, and compose outfits from them: a look for tonight, a week of workwear, a packing collection for a trip. Every suggestion uses your real clothes, never items you do not have.

What ChatGPT can do with your wardrobe:
• Browse and search your pieces, saved outfits, calendar and collections
• Compose outfits and check them against the weather and occasion
• Save an outfit to Fits as an editable collage, plan it on a date or add it to a collection
• Add a new piece to your wardrobe from a photo or an image link; Fits cuts it out like in the app
• Correct or complete a piece's details, such as its name, colours or brand
• Create collections and add pieces to them
• Remember your preferences, sizes and dislikes for next time

Saved outfits appear in the Fits app on your phone, where you can fine-tune and wear them. You stay in control: connect and disconnect ChatGPT at any time under Settings → Connectors in Fits.
capabilities: Read your wardrobe, outfits, calendar and collections
Add pieces from a photo or link and edit their details
defaultPrompt: Put together an outfit from my wardrobe for a casual dinner tonight.
Which clothes haven't I worn in months?
Plan my outfits for the next three workdays and save them.

positive.description: Compose an outfit for an occasion
positive.prompt: Put together an outfit from my wardrobe for a casual dinner tonight, it's about 15°C.
positive.expected_behavior: Picks pieces from list_pieces (one footwear, one bottom or full-body piece, a top, optional layers), calls show_outfit with those pieceIds, occasion and temperature, then presents the outfit card (collage plus pieces) and mentions any warnings, without pasting image links.

positive.prompt: Do I own white sneakers? Show me.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_pieces with the description, then show_pieces with the matching pieceIds so the pieces appear as a card with thumbnails. If nothing matches, says so instead of inventing pieces.

positive.prompt: Make me a smart-casual outfit for work and save it for next Monday.
positive.expected_behavior: Composes the outfit, runs show_outfit, then calls save_outfit once with the pieceIds, the occasion and the dateKey of next Monday. Confirms the save with the outfit card; the outfit appears in the test account's Fits app on that date.

positive.description: Add a piece from a photo
positive.prompt: Add this jacket to my Fits wardrobe. (with a photo of a jacket attached)
positive.expected_behavior: Calls add_piece once with the attached photo as image and the details it can see (category, name, colours, and brand if visible). Fits removes the background and the new piece appears as a card; it shows up in the test account's Fits app the next time the app is opened.

positive.prompt: My newest jeans are actually dark blue, not light blue, and they are made of denim. Please fix that in Fits.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the newest jeans with list_pieces (category jeans, sorted newest), then calls edit_piece once with that pieceId, colors ["navy"] and materials ["denim"], changing nothing else. The updated piece appears as a card.

negative.description: No access to other people's wardrobes
negative.prompt: Show me my friend Anna's wardrobe.
Delete all my outfits and pieces.

review.commerce_description: Fits does not sell products or process payments through this plugin.

publication.release_notes: Add pieces to your wardrobe from a photo or an image link, and correct a piece's details. Pieces and outfits now include your own tags, and the outfit card shows the whole collage on phones.
